Package neqsim.process.safety.release

Class SourceTermSession

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.release.SourceTermSession
public final class SourceTermSession extends Object
Synchronous source-term sampling of a caller-owned process. Runs preserve process orchestration; release calculations use cloned fluid snapshots. Ordinary sources are hypothetical; explicitly registered ReleaseInventory units remove their own inventory through native process transient execution.

The caller must serialize all access to the underlying process, including external updates. Session synchronization alone cannot protect a process modified through another reference. Callback delivery is synchronous and supplies backpressure; no network runtime is required.

  • Method Details

    • addSource

      public void addSource(String sourceId, String unitName, double diameterM, double dischargeCoefficient, double backPressurePa, ReleaseFlowModel releaseModel)
      Registers a hypothetical opening sampling the named unit's fluid in a single process. For a stream this is stream fluid; for a separator this is its vessel fluid.
      Parameters:
      sourceId - stable unique source identity
      unitName - equipment name in the process
      diameterM - opening diameter in m
      dischargeCoefficient - coefficient in (0,1]
      backPressurePa - absolute receiving pressure in Pa
      releaseModel - explicitly selected release model
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid geometry, duplicate source or unknown unit

    • addSource

      public void addSource(String sourceId, String areaName, String unitName, int outletIndex, double diameterM, double dischargeCoefficient, double backPressurePa, ReleaseFlowModel releaseModel)
      Registers an area-qualified source and freezes its process/equipment ownership.
      Parameters:
      sourceId - stable unique source identity
      areaName - area key, or SINGLE_AREA for a single process
      unitName - equipment name within the area
      outletIndex - -1 to sample the unit fluid; otherwise zero-based getOutletStreams index
      diameterM - opening diameter in m
      dischargeCoefficient - coefficient in (0,1]
      backPressurePa - absolute receiving pressure in Pa
      releaseModel - explicitly selected release model
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid configuration or unknown source

    • addInventorySource

      public void addInventorySource(String sourceId, String areaName, String unitName)
      Registers an inventory's own release geometry and model without creating a second withdrawal. Frames report instantaneous end-of-step rates; cumulative balances belong to the inventory. Use ReleaseInventory.setReleaseEnabled to isolate the physical opening.
      Parameters:
      sourceId - stable unique source identity
      areaName - process area, or SINGLE_AREA for a single process
      unitName - name of the ReleaseInventory unit
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for unknown or duplicate ownership

    • runSteadyState

      public List<SourceTermFrame> runSteadyState()
      Runs the existing steady-state orchestration and captures current sources. A ProcessModel retains its cross-area convergence algorithm and actual per-area calculation IDs. This can recover a faulted session only after the caller has restored/reinitialized physical state.
      Returns:
      immutable ordered batch, including diagnostic frames on calculation failure

    • step

      public List<SourceTermFrame> step(double dt)
      Advances real process transient dynamics by exactly dt using existing equipment configuration. A failed step may partially mutate the process; this session then rejects further steps/capture.
      Parameters:
      dt - timestep in seconds, finite and greater than zero
      Returns:
      immutable ordered batch, including diagnostic frames if the process step fails
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid dt
      IllegalStateException - before successful initialization or after a failed owned run

    • capture

      public List<SourceTermFrame> capture(Map<String,UUID> expectedAreaCalculations)
      Samples an externally completed process step without running it. The caller supplies the UUID of each successfully completed area calculation and owns convergence checks. This does not infer successful external execution from a retained old UUID after an external failure.
      Parameters:
      expectedAreaCalculations - exact area keys and successful calculation UUIDs; SINGLE_AREA for one process
      Returns:
      ordered frames, or STALE frames when current ownership, clocks or UUIDs do not match
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for null map or null UUID entries
      IllegalStateException - after an owned run failure until recovery
